login.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.

shell.headline: One place to govern every AI agent you run.
shell.selfHosted: Self-hosted: the engine, the audit ledger and your data stay on your own infrastructure.
shell.audited: Every action is written to a hash-chained, signed audit ledger you can verify yourself.
shell.onePlane: Providers, agents, policies and spend in one console, not five.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.subtitle: Choose a password to activate your account.
invite.weakPassword: Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is not valid. It may have expired or already been used — ask your administrator for a new invitation.
invite.missingToken: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the link exactly as it appears in your invitation email.
invite.success: Your account is active. Sign in with your new password.

setup.title: First-boot setup
setup.subtitle: No administrator exists yet. Create the first one with the one-time setup token Olivares printed when it first started.
setup.tokenHint: It is in the output of that first start: the terminal that ran Olivares, `docker logs` for a container, or `journalctl -u olivares` for the system service. While no administrator exists, `olivares first-boot --new-token` prints a replacement.
setup.done: Administrator created. Sign in to continue.
setup.invalidToken: That setup token is not valid. While no administrator exists, run `olivares first-boot --new-token` where the engine runs: it prints a replacement and retires every earlier token.

firstRun.createDescription: The control plane has no organization yet, and everything in the console belongs to one. Create it here — its default workspace and its audit ledger are provisioned with it.
firstRun.name: Organization name
firstRun.chooseDescription: Your account administers more than one organization. Pick the one to work in — you can switch at any time from the top bar.
firstRun.unavailableDescription: The control plane did not answer, so the console cannot tell whether an organization exists. Nothing was created.

session.expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

tenant.label: Organization
tenant.noneHint: Your account is not a member of any organization yet.

secondFactor.codePrompt: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
secondFactor.invalid: That code did not verify. Start again with a fresh code.
secondFactor.unavailable: Second-factor sign-in is unavailable on this deployment.
secondFactor.enrolmentRequired: Your administrator requires a second factor. Register one now to finish signing in.
secondFactor.qrAlt: QR code with the TOTP provisioning URI
secondFactor.recoveryWarning: These recovery codes are shown only once. Store them now — each can be used a single time if you lose your device.

signIn.title: 2. Sign in
signIn.hint: It asks for your email and password. If this engine uses a self-signed certificate, first copy its tls.crt file from the engine's data directory to the folder where you run the command.
signIn.hintPin: It asks for your email and password. The pin is this engine's certificate fingerprint, so the CLI trusts this engine.

start.title: 3. Start a session
start.hint: Run it in the folder to work on.
